author: Pallas, 1764
summary: 봄과 가을에 우리나라를 지나가는 나그네새로, 바닷가 간석지 같은 곳에서 지낸다. 주로 곤충을 먹지만 작은 조개, 올챙이, 작은 물고기, 갑각류도 먹는다. 알은 4개를 낳는다. 국내에서는 서울, 일산, 장단, 개성, 안주, 해주, 만포, 온성, 용암포, 포항 등지를 거쳐 간다.

points.en: dark grey head and neck with white chin (breeding)
slightly glossy upperparts scattered with white spots (breeding)

art.subject: Spotted Redshank (Tringa erythropus), adult in breeding plumage: dark grey head, neck and underparts, white chin and white tips to the hindneck feathers, slightly glossy upperparts scattered with white spots, white rump, black uppertail coverts barred white, black tail with grey bars or white markings, white streaks on the axillaries and undertail coverts

views: adult breeding, side view standing: dark grey head, neck and underparts, white chin, upperparts spotted white
adult winter, side view standing: plain grey-brown head and upperparts, pale grey streaks on the neck sides
